description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for staff.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while upholding the highest standards of quality and operational efficiency. You will guide a team of healthcare professionals, manage budgets, and drive initiatives that enhance resident satisfaction and outcomes.

This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a reputable organization. If you are a proven leader with a commitment to excellence in long-term care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong leadership, financial management, and operational skills.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to foster a positive and compliant work environment.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This full-time role offers a competitive salary of $65,000 - $75,000 per year, providing an excellent opportunity for a professional committed to resident care and accurate documentation. We are looking for a permanent team member, not an interim placement.As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for the timely and accurate completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with all federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in coordinating the interdisciplinary care planning process and optimizing reimbursement. Join a supportive environment where your skills are valued and contribute to the well-being of our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa or a compact state
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
